detail: The historical seven features were selected using the same 219 labels; every v13 absolute AUC remains exploratory.
Stage 3 evaluates many add-one candidates; raw maximum AUC is not confirmatory and FDR correction is required.
Stage 4 nests selection of the eighth feature only; it cannot undo historical selection of the base seven.
Median imputation, scaling and tuning are fitted inside training folds only.
